answer_1.quote: We evaluate the utility of DEFT-UCS in the context of instruction-based fine-tuning for multiple text editing tasks.

answer_2.quote: We examine SARI and ROUGE-L scores for our quantitative evaluations.

answer_4.quote: We hired three computer scientists with English as their primary language for our human evaluation.
answer_4.guideline: For each sample in the human-eval test set, evaluators were provided two edited sentences generated using M_Flan-T5-LG_DEFT-UCS and M_CoEDIT. Evaluators selected which edit was accurately edited or if both were similar or identical.
